snippet.title: Fears to Fathom® - Scratch Creek | Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Tessa's trailer.

After noticing bone-chilling similarities to an episode of Fears to Fathom, Tessa and Marcus decide to share their own experience. Scratch Creek is an exclusively co-op experience.
